report_scope: Aggregate of recorded validations plus current storage/provider configuration. Does not rerun tests/source validation; application startup independently verifies inputs.

source_readiness.deployment_licence_review: required: older mixed GBA distribution, source-specific conditions and ODbL obligations
source_readiness.osm_incomplete_relation_scope: Unknown geometry remains explicit; names or country-edge metadata do not prove exclusion from requested support

readiness_definitions.acquisition_ready: All selected core source artifacts acquired and validated; this does not assert the terrain buffer is supplied
readiness_definitions.normalized_artifacts_complete: All core normalized artifacts and quality reports published; recorded geographic gaps may remain
readiness_definitions.normalized_ready: All core normalized artifacts and quality reports completed without unresolved geometry errors or unlocated incomplete relations
readiness_definitions.visibility_ready: Requires supported terrain and obstruction surfaces over complete modeled windows; remains false for the missing surrounding terrain
